DDL	create table char_tbl(c char(5), v varchar(6)) using parquet
READ	desc formatted char_tbl
READ	desc formatted char_tbl c
READ	show create table char_tbl
DDL	create table char_tbl2 using parquet as select * from char_tbl
READ	show create table char_tbl2
READ	desc formatted char_tbl2
READ	desc formatted char_tbl2 c
DDL	create table char_tbl3 like char_tbl
READ	desc formatted char_tbl3
READ	desc formatted char_tbl3 c
READ	show create table char_tbl3
DDL	create view char_view as select * from char_tbl
READ	desc formatted char_view
READ	desc formatted char_view c
READ	show create table char_view
DDL	alter table char_tbl rename to char_tbl1
READ	desc formatted char_tbl1
DDL	alter table char_tbl1 change column c type char(6)
DDL	alter table char_tbl1 change column c type char(5)
READ	desc formatted char_tbl1
DDL	alter table char_tbl1 add columns (d char(5))
READ	desc formatted char_tbl1
DDL	alter view char_view as select * from char_tbl2
READ	desc formatted char_view
DDL	alter table char_tbl1 SET TBLPROPERTIES('yes'='no')
READ	desc formatted char_tbl1
DDL	alter view char_view SET TBLPROPERTIES('yes'='no')
READ	desc formatted char_view
DDL	alter table char_tbl1 UNSET TBLPROPERTIES('yes')
READ	desc formatted char_tbl1
DDL	alter view char_view UNSET TBLPROPERTIES('yes')
READ	desc formatted char_view
DDL	alter table char_tbl1 SET SERDEPROPERTIES('yes'='no')
READ	desc formatted char_tbl1
DDL	create table char_part(c1 char(5), c2 char(2), v1 varchar(6), v2 varchar(2)) using parquet partitioned by (v2, c2)
READ	desc formatted char_part
DDL	alter table char_part change column c1 comment 'char comment'
DDL	alter table char_part change column v1 comment 'varchar comment'
DDL	alter table char_part add partition (v2='ke', c2='nt') location 'loc1'
READ	desc formatted char_part
DDL	alter table char_part partition (v2='ke') rename to partition (v2='nt')
READ	desc formatted char_part
DDL	alter table char_part partition (v2='ke', c2='nt') set location 'loc2'
READ	desc formatted char_part
DDL	MSCK REPAIR TABLE char_part
READ	desc formatted char_part
SESSION	create temporary view str_view as select c, v from values
DDL	create table char_tbl4(c7 char(7), c8 char(8), v varchar(6), s string) using parquet
WRITE	insert into char_tbl4 select c, c, v, c from str_view
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4 where c7 = c8
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4 where c7 = v
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4 where c7 = s
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4 where c7 = 'NetEase               '
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4 where v = 'Spark '
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4 order by c7
READ	select c7, c8, v, s from char_tbl4 order by v
READ	select ascii(c7), ascii(c8), ascii(v), ascii(s) from char_tbl4
READ	select base64(c7), base64(c8), base64(v), ascii(s) from char_tbl4
READ	select bit_length(c7), bit_length(c8), bit_length(v), bit_length(s) from char_tbl4
READ	select char_length(c7), char_length(c8), char_length(v), char_length(s) from char_tbl4
READ	select octet_length(c7), octet_length(c8), octet_length(v), octet_length(s) from char_tbl4
READ	select concat_ws('|', c7, c8), concat_ws('|', c7, v), concat_ws('|', c7, s), concat_ws('|', v, s) from char_tbl4
READ	select concat(c7, c8), concat(c7, v), concat(c7, s), concat(v, s) from char_tbl4
READ	select like(c7, 'Ne     _'), like(c8, 'Ne     _') from char_tbl4
READ	select like(v, 'Spark_') from char_tbl4
READ	select c7 = c8, upper(c7) = upper(c8), lower(c7) = lower(c8) from char_tbl4 where s = 'NetEase'
READ	select c7 = s, upper(c7) = upper(s), lower(c7) = lower(s) from char_tbl4 where s = 'NetEase'
READ	select c7 = 'NetEase', upper(c7) = upper('NetEase'), lower(c7) = lower('NetEase') from char_tbl4 where s = 'NetEase'
READ	select printf('Hey, %s%s%s%s', c7, c8, v, s) from char_tbl4
READ	select repeat(c7, 2), repeat(c8, 2), repeat(v, 2), repeat(s, 2) from char_tbl4
READ	select replace(c7, 'Net', 'Apache'), replace(c8, 'Net', 'Apache'), replace(v, 'Spark', 'Kyuubi'), replace(s, 'Net', 'Apa
READ	select rpad(c7, 10), rpad(c8, 5), rpad(v, 5), rpad(s, 5)  from char_tbl4
READ	select rtrim(c7), rtrim(c8), rtrim(v), rtrim(s) from char_tbl4
READ	select split(c7, 'e'), split(c8, 'e'), split(v, 'a'), split(s, 'e') from char_tbl4
READ	select substring(c7, 2), substring(c8, 2), substring(v, 3), substring(s, 2) from char_tbl4
READ	select left(c7, 2), left(c8, 2), left(v, 3), left(s, 2) from char_tbl4
READ	select right(c7, 2), right(c8, 2), right(v, 3), right(s, 2) from char_tbl4
READ	select typeof(c7), typeof(c8), typeof(v), typeof(s) from char_tbl4 limit 1
READ	select cast(c7 as char(1)), cast(c8 as char(10)), cast(v as char(1)), cast(v as varchar(1)), cast(s as char(5)) from cha
DDL	drop table char_tbl1
DDL	drop table char_tbl2
DDL	drop table char_tbl3
DDL	drop table char_tbl4
READ	select ascii('§'), ascii('÷'), ascii('×10')
READ	select chr(167), chr(247), chr(215)
READ	SELECT to_varchar(78.12, '$99.99')
READ	SELECT to_varchar(111.11, '99.9')
READ	SELECT to_varchar(12454.8, '99,999.9S')
